meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 成为 bug 调查员:它会核实最新源码、判断缺陷属于 LazyCodex 仓库还是上游 Codex 仓库,然后创建带根因、复现步骤和修复建议的 GitHub issue,必要时还会生成 PR。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发,尤其是需要源码依据的根因分析、复现步骤或 GitHub 路由。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 报个 bug,附上根因和复现步骤。
say.note: Claude 会核查源码后创建 issue。

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 崩溃,查一下最新源码判断归属。
say.note: 它会先拉取最新源码再决定仓库。

say.text: 在 openai/codex 上为这个修复创建 PR。
say.note: 只有上游仓库才允许创建 PR。

howto.what_en: This skill turns Claude into a bug investigator: it verifies latest source code, decides whether the defect belongs to the LazyCodex repo or upstream Codex repo, then creates a GitHub issue with root cause, reproduction steps, and fix guidance, or a PR when allowed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when source-backed root cause, reproduction, or GitHub routing is needed.

say_en.text: File a bug for LazyCodex with root cause and repro steps.
say_en.note: Claude verifies source and creates an issue.

say_en.text: This Codex CLI crash—check the latest source and route it.
say_en.note: It syncs latest source before deciding the repo.

say_en.text: Create a PR for this fix on openai/codex.
say_en.note: PRs are allowed only for the upstream repo.
